Apple's FY2024 (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024) results, per the Consolidated Statements of Operations in its FY2024 10-K, were:

- Total net sales: $391,035 million
- Cost of sales: $210,352 million
- Gross margin (dollar amount): $180,683 million [DOC: apple_10k_fy2024.txt — "Total net sales: $391,035; Cost of sales: $210,352; Gross margin: $180,683"]

This corresponds to a gross margin percentage of approximately 46.2% ($180,683M / $391,035M), up slightly from 44.1% in FY2023 ($169,148M / $383,285M) [DOC: apple_10k_fy2024.txt — "Fiscal year ended September 30, 2023 ... Gross margin: $169,148"].

ANSWER: Apple's FY2024 gross margin was $180,683 million, or approximately 46.2% of net sales ($180,683M / $391,035M total net sales).
